blocks.text: Deuteronomy 14 contains 29 verses. It opens with: Ye are the children of Jehovah your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead. It concludes with: and the Levite, because he hath no portion nor inheritance with thee, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Jehovah thy God may bless thee in all the work of thy hand which thou doest.
